title: Olive Branch Scarf, Lightweight Botanical Print Scarf, Mediterranean Olive Pattern Scarf, Gift for Her
description:
Little olive branches with purple and green olives scattered on a soft cream background: an elegant, timeless Mediterranean pattern that goes with camel, navy and denim all year round.

DETAILS
- Lightweight, slightly sheer 100% polyester scarf
- One size: 27 x 71 in (69 x 180 cm)
- Printed on one side, the pattern shows through softly on the back
- Seamless construction, finished edges
- Hand wash cold or gentle cycle, hang to dry, cool iron if needed

PRODUCTION AND SHIPPING
Printed on demand by our production partner in the USA and shipped with tracking. Production takes 2-5 business days. Free shipping within the USA; this item ships to the USA and Canada only.

Design created by MurettoStudio with the help of AI image tools, then checked and prepared for print by me.

Photos: the first photo is the product mockup from our print partner; the lifestyle photos are digital mockups created for illustration.
